answer: By the ember of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The kernel holds work receipts rather than names, so the copper of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
